start: MettleUp Plus, watch app installed and connected

steps.action: Start a workout on the phone
user_sees: Within a few seconds the watch shows the exercise, the set line, last time's numbers, the goal and 'Complete set', in the gym's colour
must_not: The watch stuck on an old workout
Another exercise than the phone's

steps.action: Tick a set on the phone
user_sees: The watch shows the rest countdown with the next set and buzzes at its end
must_not: The watch countdown ending at a different time than the phone

steps.action: Tap 'Finish' on the phone
user_sees: The watch shows 'Workout saved' for about 4 s, then no workout
must_not: The watch still showing the workout

s3 see (data only): Finish tells the watch the workout was saved

start: Workout open, watch out of Bluetooth range

steps.action: Tick two sets on the phone, then bring the watch back in range

start: A phone with no Wear OS support

steps.action: Start a workout
user_sees: Nothing about a watch; sync pauses quietly
must_not: An error message about a watch
Battery drain from endless retries

start: Workout open and shown on the watch

steps.action: Discard the workout on the phone
user_sees: The watch shows no workout, without 'Workout saved'
must_not: 'Workout saved' on the watch for a discarded workout

steps.action: Skip a rest on the phone
user_sees: The watch countdown goes
must_not: The watch buzzing later for the skipped rest

tests.checks: s1 see / s1 not (data only): a discard clears the watch as not saved
s1 not: only a Finish of an open workout shows 'Workout saved' (watch unit)
